items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: First of all, Roy Eldridge, then Joe Newman and -- oh, my goodness, let me think.

ctx.x: Now, can you think of a trumpet -- anybody who played the trumpet who had a comparable or similar kind of harmonic sophistication?

Oh, yes, if I can think about a few whom I remember. First of all, Roy Eldridge, then Joe Newman and -- oh, my goodness, let me think. I made a recording or two with a trumpet player, forget his name offhand. Name a couple that you remember.
